items.title: Emile Christian and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-02-11
items.q: The Varicella mentioned Henry Bruness on trombone.

ctx.x: Oh, was he a hard man? No, Richie was straight. Somebody told me he had a real powerful tone. You could hear him across the river. Oh, yeah. Yeah. He did have powerful tones. Yeah.

All the Brunesses had powerful tones. And the Varicella mentioned Henry Bruness on trombone. That's right. Well, he died pretty early, couldn't he? Yeah. Yeah, let me get you an act. Right here is an act. The Varicella mentioned Henry Bruness.
